title: Chapter - 3 TYPES OF PRISON INMATES The Prison inmates or population who are lodged in the numerous prisons can be categorised differently depending upon their Nationality, Sex, the stage of hearing of theic Gases in courts of law etc. The Prison population consists of Convicts, Under Trials, Detenus etc. This population can also be studied by other classification such as Women prisoners, Foreigners, Lunatics etc. During 1995, for the period indicated, information on prisoners who were Convicts, Under Trials, Detemus and Others alongwith male, female break-up is available. columns.name: PRISON STATISTICS - 1995 During the year 1995, the highest number of Under Trial Prisoners (42528) who were kept in the various jails was reported from Tamil Nadu. This was followed by Uttar | The other states which also reported high number of under trials in their custody during 1995 were Kerala (28972), Karnataka (26122), Maharashtra (15050), Rajasthan (6075) and Orissa (5678). Some of the States had large number of the under trials kept in the Central Jail. The number of under trials kept in the central jail of the various States were Tamil Nadu Karnataka (8049), Bihar (6967), Rajasthan (2045), Kerala & Kashmir (368) and Mizoram (1047), Manipur (518), Jammu The other States had either kept most of the under trials in district jails or sub accommodated Uttar Pradesh (30963), Bihar (15963), Maharashtra (5331) mainly The jails exclusively meant to lodge women prisoners reported larger population | of under trials from Tamil Nadu (917) & Kerala (33). the detailed information Number of Under Trials in fails Total Number of Under Trials kept in | Women Jail
